name: ER-SDE noise scaler
plain: ER-SDE uses a nonlinear noise scaler function of the noise-to-signal lambda (σ/α) as a custom noise schedule. The noise amount is set by a chosen function rather than by eta.
math: default scaler f(x) = x·(exp(x^0.3) + 10). λ=σ/α, r=f(λ_t)/f(λ_s). Noise term: x ← x + α_t·ε·s_noise·√(λ_t²−λ_s²·r²) per sampling.py:1654.
label: from code

audit.note: sampling.py:1613: er_lambda is σ/α = exp(−half_log_snr), a noise-to-signal ratio, not a log quantity, so 'logSNR-style' misdescribes it. Formula and sampling.py:1654 are right.
